text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's with... this crowd of 
people?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're selling limited-edition 
sweets. Fruit tarts supervised by a famous 
pastry chef! But the crowd wanting them is 
rushing in...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh. No one can escape the battle over 
sweets... This promises to be a thrilling 
contest.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's decide the buyer with a 
game, you two. Only the last one 
standing... shall claim the 
limited-edition sweets...!

While looking for Rulership for their 
meeting, I spotted an unusually lively 
crowd in a corner of the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's "Gin Rummy"—a two-player game 
where you form sets like in mahjong and 
try to reduce the deadwood in your hand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You read your opponent's hand from the 
discard pile, and try to get the total 
points of your unwanted cards as close to 
0 as possible."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Plus the tactic of 'passing off' deadwood 
to stage a comeback, and going out with 
zero deadwood to block layoffs with a 
'Perfect Call'— the rules are truly 
profound."
choice_data_list:
This looks like the kind of game you'd 
like.

This seems like the kind of game you'd 
like.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, reading your opponent matters more 
than random factors. That suits me much 
better.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Now then... among the lineup likely to 
advance from this battle...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—And that is checkmate. As this is a duel, 
I shall show no mercy. Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Just as calculated. This is my victory. 
To study the recipe, I shall go claim the 
tart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. If we manage to win, let's share 
the sweets with everyone bit by bit."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Heh. By what twist of fate did we end up 
with this lineup? Then again... I wouldn't 
have it any other way.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What, four 'Pass the Buck' cards—!? 
...Splendid. You win.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I failed to anticipate the trick play. To 
think the plan was to let me take the lead 
first and turn the tables by passing the 
penalty onto me...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A true strategy... means guiding even your 
opponent's hand. A win is a win, don't 
take it personally.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san's race execution... caught me off 
guard. It seems my calculations were still 
lacking.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: No, no, not at all. I just got lucky.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—I had a feeling I'd face you in the 
finals. Well then... shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hold on... I'll be taking that discarded 
2. It's one of my vital pieces.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(...With this, I'll make Pisa think my 
hand revolves around that discard I just 
made...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(However, in reality, I'm building a 
different hand. That discarded 2 won't be 
part of the final meld. It's a bluff. 
Sorry, but—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'll discard one more card, a 2.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'll discard a 2 again. Hehe... Now, I've 
created a connection.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Pisa rolled a 2 again... That's three 
times in a row now...? Don't tell me—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Did you deliberately break up a 
combination of cards that was already 
matching?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... What's Pisa aiming for? At this 
rate, we'll just fall right into their 
pace—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...No, calm down. Pisa said that she 
"managed to build a connection"...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Pisa's habit of trying to 'connect' 
everything and anything, and those three 
unnatural discards of 2s in a row..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe at first, but is 
Pisa... trying to connect every single 
number in her hand?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(If they made it all the way to the finals 
with such a high-risk playstyle... they're 
truly not to be underestimated.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(If Pisa is gathering all "Sequences" in 
her hand—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(If I move up half-heartedly, they'll 
likely turn the tables on me by "rubbing 
off"...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (There are two ways——to evade this.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(A 'perfect discard' that prevents anyone 
from blaming me... I'll aim for that by 
getting rid of all unnecessary tiles.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Another option is to sacrifice my own 
hand to block Pisa's sequence yaku.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—...I've made up my mind. This is my 
masterstroke... to defeat you...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh! Rulership won!
choice_data_list: That was a bold power play, huh.
That was a bold power play, wasn't it?

You were quick to make the call once you'd 
read the situation.

You were quick to make the call once you'd 
read the situation, weren't you.

text_block_list.text: Oh! Rulership won!

text_block_list.text:
It was a victory born of aggressive 
play—piling up yaku without fearing an 
opponent's win until reaching a "flawless 
hand."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Strategies and tactics exist solely 
to 'win.' If you lose, none of it matters. 
If necessary... I'm willing to gamble.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That was truly a great match, everyone. 
The sweets are... my thanks for 
entertaining me. Whoever wants some, help 
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Ooooh—!"

And thus, everyone decided to split the 
limited-edition sweets and share them 
together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—I read that Pisa would obsess over 
consecutive wins, and played accordingly. 
I thoroughly hoarded every card she 
wanted.
choice_data_list:
Didn't think my prediction would be off, 
huh.
I didn't think my prediction would be off.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. If I didn't trust my own reads, I 
wouldn't have stepped onto the board in 
the first place.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll have... just a few sweets. I used my 
brain, after all. Heh... not a bad 
feeling.
